name: A7A5
oneLiner: A7A5 is Old Vector's RUB stablecoin backed by an undisclosed mix of ruble deposits and short-term assets; its issuer network faces OFAC, EU, and UK sanctions.
collateral: An undisclosed Russian-ruble reserve basket that issuer materials variously describe as deposits and as deposits plus short-term assets; current constituent weights, institutions, custody, and assurance evidence are unavailable
pegMechanism: Fiat-backed 1:1 peg to the Russian ruble enforced via off-chain primary-market mint and redemption with KYC-verified authorized partners (e.g. a7a5.kg for Russian-account holders depositing or withdrawing RUB); the issuer roadmap also identifies A7A5/USDT swaps on Tron, while A7A5's peg currency remains RUB; since 2026-02-09 the issuer (Old Vector LLC) distributes nearly all overnight reserve income to holders as additional A7A5 using a formula of the Central Bank of Russia key rate minus 1 percentage point, recalculated when the key rate changes

proofOfReserves.provider: A7A5 issuer transparency page (reviewed 2026-10-01: no current reserve report or composition is published there; the former audit.pdf endpoint serves an application HTML shell)

jurisdiction.license: Virtual-asset issue registered by Finnadzor; issuer: Old Vector LLC (regulator statement 2025-07-21); specific VASP licensing scope not independently verified

yieldConfig.yieldSource: Central Bank of Russia key rate minus 1pp issuer distribution

notices.title: Multi-jurisdiction sanctions exposure
notices.message: A7A5 and related infrastructure are subject to major sanctions risk. OFAC designated Grinex and A7-linked entities in August 2025, and the A7A5 token, issuer network, and venues such as Grinex/TengriCoin have also been targeted by EU and UK sanctions actions tied to Russian sanctions-evasion infrastructure.
